selection_rule: Every active capability repository has exactly one owner_skill. A different Skill may call that repository only when it is explicitly listed in consumer_skills; consuming evidence never transfers policy ownership. If no consumer relationship exists, hand off to the repository owner instead of calling the repository directly.
cross_skill_rule: Cross-skill repository use is deny-by-default and must be explicit, minimal and evidence-scoped. Repositories never call or absorb another domain repository merely because their tools overlap.

core_repositories.call_when: Remote GitHub work needs wait/resume, dependency waves, persistent transport state or correlated multi-run evidence.
core_repositories.do_not_call_when: A native app, browser, local/Codex runtime or one specialist repository can return the required evidence directly.

core_repositories.call_when: Design needs reproducible browser, accessibility, Lighthouse, markup, baseline or visual-diff evidence; Website QA may consume the same bounded evidence for independent release validation.
core_repositories.do_not_call_when: The task is a design decision, WordPress/Elementor code fix, SEO crawl, live site mutation or a QA flow that needs authenticated/staging behaviour instead of reproducible public evidence.

core_repositories.call_when: SEO needs reproducible crawl, indexability, Lighthouse, Nu HTML or technical regression evidence.
core_repositories.do_not_call_when: The task is UX/design, independent release QA, WordPress implementation or a live Google ranking/index-status claim that requires another authoritative source.

core_repositories.call_when: Elementor needs source validation, import/roundtrip, controlled render, responsive browser evidence or native V3/V4 Kit-contract validation.
core_repositories.do_not_call_when: The task is live WordPress mutation, generic WordPress plugin auditing, visual strategy or independent release acceptance.

core_repositories.call_when: WordPress Quality Architect needs standardized remote/cross-repository plugin audit evidence, or an explicitly requested fast accountless Playground smoke that does not require MySQL/hosting parity.
core_repositories.do_not_call_when: The task is a live WordPress write, Elementor JSON/runtime ownership, SEO crawling, design/QA evidence or a product-specific runtime that has not been enabled by a validated profile.

core_repositories.call_when: WordPress Quality Architect needs the canonical authenticated live WordPress read/write/rollback bridge; Elementor may consume it for target-locked live WordPress/Elementor inventory, import, readback or rollback after the required preflight.
core_repositories.do_not_call_when: The task is source-only audit, SEO crawling, design evidence, independent QA browser testing or any write without health/auth/capability/site/dry-run/approval gates.

core_repositories.call_when: The transcribeer mode needs accountless acquisition of captions from a direct public YouTube video or Short URL.
core_repositories.do_not_call_when: The source requires login, cookies, CAPTCHA, proxy bypass, playlist/channel discovery, audio download or Whisper/media transcription.

core_repositories.call_when: Leads needs its bounded public prospect discovery, website evidence, qualification, contact enrichment, preparation or explicitly gated outreach runtime.
core_repositories.do_not_call_when: The task is generic SEO/design/QA scanning, WordPress implementation, or any live outreach without the Leads compliance, sender and permission gates.

core_repositories.call_when: Vacature Search needs deterministic canonicalization/gates/ranking or its isolated ingestion sibling must normalize approved public ATS/API/JobPosting sources into JobObservations for semantic review.
core_repositories.do_not_call_when: The task is source-policy selection, authenticity judgement, candidate fit, CV evidence, application state, outreach, or generic web extraction outside the vacancy domain.

remove_after: documented regression period completes without replacement-evidence regressions
state-token and capability-inventory parity is tested
all active site routes use wordpressconnector
release users are directed to the canonical repository

deprecated_repositories.reason: design-kit generation and native V3/V4 kit validation belong to the Elementor runtime
